comment: The panel prints Clock over the jack that configInput calls Trigger, and M-Rnd, S-Rnd and S-Inv over the randomize-mode, randomize-steps and invert jacks; the Signal input and the Mode switch carry no lettering at all. compute_weights at src/switch18.cpp:141 zeroes the weight of any step whose output jack is unpatched, which is what makes an unconnected output unreachable. A weight CV replaces the knob's value and is then multiplied by it, so the knob works as an attenuator once a cable is present rather than adding to the CV. The invert behaviour is an exclusive-or of the invert switch and the invert jack's gate level (src/switch18.cpp:171), so either one alone inverts and both together cancel; the switch's two choice names, Invert on Low and Invert on High, are ambiguous about which of the two they describe and are not quoted for that reason. All nine weight CV jacks carry the maker's second line 'Expects a 0-10V signal' and nothing more.
